notes: Ground truth for the retrieval layer, the counterpart to the per-specimen
extraction ground truth. Each query names a TARGET CLAUSE, not a target row.
Scoring is deliberately document-agnostic. All six specimens are the same
Perpres 16/2018 standard form, so the same clause exists in several of them
at near-identical distance. A query passes when ANY document's copy of the
expected clause appears in the top-k. Returning the right clause from the
'wrong' contract is a correct answer to a corpus-wide semantic query.
A sub-clause beneath the expected clause also passes. A clause node holds a
heading and lead text, while the provision a question is really about
usually sits in a numbered child: clause 55 is 'Asuransi', and 55.2 is the
sentence obliging the provider to insure third parties. The relation is
one-directional — a descendant passes, an ancestor does not, because
returning a whole section for a clause question is a precision loss.
A clause is identified by (sub_document, hierarchy_path, label) — the
document-agnostic part of the embedding_id key. See retrieval/schema.py for
why the full id also carries document_key, page, text and occurrence.
Known limitation, deliberately not worked around here: the section letter is
part of the clause path in Rancangan Kontrak and rehabGedung ('C/55') but
absent in kontrakJasa and pembangunanRumah ('55'), so each SSUK clause forms
two classes of two documents rather than one class of four. That is an
upstream structure defect. Loosening this key to hide it would make the gate
stop reporting it, so 'expect_documents' records 2 and stays honest.
Targets were chosen by reading clause content in the corpus and picking a
query a user would plausibly type for it. They were NOT chosen by running a
query first and blessing whatever came back — that would make the harness
measure its own output. 'expect_documents' records how many specimens hold
the clause at authoring time; the harness reports it but does not fail on it,
since adding a specimen legitimately changes that count.

queries.query: sanksi denda akibat wanprestasi dan keterlambatan penyelesaian pekerjaan
queries.why: Clause 62 'Pembayaran Denda' is the clause that obliges the provider to pay a financial penalty for wanprestasi.

queries.query: keadaan kahar force majeure di luar kendali para pihak
queries.why: Clause 41 is the force majeure clause.

queries.query: jaminan pelaksanaan dan jaminan uang muka
queries.why: Clause 63 'Jaminan' collects the contract guarantee instruments.
Clause 45 is termination BY the provider, distinct from clause 44 (termination by the signing official). A retriever that confuses the two fails here.

queries.query: penyelesaian perselisihan sengketa arbitrase antara para pihak
queries.why: Clause 79 is the dispute resolution clause.

queries.query: kewajiban penyedia mengasuransikan pekerjaan dan peralatan
perlindungan dan keselamatan tenaga kerja konstruksi
queries.why: Clause 53 'Perlindungan Tenaga Kerja'. Competes with clause 22 (RKK), so it also tests separation of two safety-adjacent clauses.

queries.query: serah terima hasil pekerjaan kepada pejabat penandatangan kontrak
pelanggaran hak kekayaan intelektual oleh penyedia

queries.why: Clause 38 'Perubahan Harga'. Competes with clause 69 'Harga Kontrak' and clause 36 'Perubahan Kontrak' — a genuinely hard neighbourhood.
Clause 22. Contains a literal acronym, so it also checks that identifier strings survived the embedding view unmodified.

queries.query: larangan korupsi kolusi nepotisme dan penyalahgunaan wewenang
kewajiban alih pengalaman dan keahlian magang mahasiswa
queries.why: Clause 61 'Alih Pengalaman/Keahlian', triggered above a budget-ceiling threshold.

queries.query: perbaikan cacat mutu selama masa pemeliharaan
queries.why: Clause 77 'Perbaikan Cacat Mutu'. Competes with clause 76 'Pemeriksaan dan Pengujian Cacat Mutu'.

queries.query: daftar dokumen yang merupakan satu kesatuan bagian kontrak
queries.why: Pasal 4 'Dokumen Kontrak' exists in all six specimens. The widest equivalence class in the corpus — the clearest test that cross-document scoring works.

queries.query: ruang lingkup pekerjaan utama yang diperjanjikan
queries.why: Pasal 2's children are unfilled template placeholders ('................'). The clause heading still carries the meaning, so this must retrieve. Included deliberately: blank template fields are correct output for these draft specimens, not an extraction failure, and the retrieval layer must not be tuned as though they were.
